verdict.rationale: Apple's macOS page says Siri AI can find personal content across photos, mail, and notes, answer questions about on-screen content, give feedback on your writing, and act in apps based on context. It also describes data-driven suggestions such as automatic tab grouping and weak-password alerts. These cover AI insights and suggestions from user data inside the product, but only as short marketing claims. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how insights are generated from user data, independent or hands-on corroboration that these Siri AI features work as described.
